summary: Gone Kootenai National Forest lookout 16 miles NW of Libby, Montana: a cabin in the 1920s, an L-4 cab listed for 1935, and no source describing the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source gives a year for its removal.

events.note: L-4 cab listed for 1935; the page does not say whether it replaced the 1920s cabin

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one short page by firelookout.com plus the FFLA Montana list. No removal date anywhere. elevation_m is null in the record; the page gives 6,250 ft (about 1905 m). The 1935 L-4 cab is recorded as built; the source does not say whether it replaced the 1920s cabin. Counties page on montanalookouts.weebly.com also names the site but gives only a survey location; not used. No photos found.
